newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Fiskaragung sees 97 net at 104.1 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Fiskaragung sees 97 net at 104.1 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian salt producer PT Fiskaragung Perkasa is expected to book a 1997 net profit of 104.1 billion rupiah, Bisnis Indonesia quoted a company official on Friday as saying.
The newspaper quoted Fiskaragung's investor relations manager Bob Butar Butar as saying the 1997 target was 27 percent higher than its unaudited 1996 net of 82 billion rupiah.
"The 1996 unaudited net profit of 82 billion rupiah is higher than the IPO target of 71.8 billion rupiah," Butar Butar was quoted as saying.
He attributed the higher net to price increase for iodised salt to 1,348 rupiah per kg from 739 rupiah per kg in 1995.
Shares of Fiskaragung were up 100 rupiah to 3,950 rupiah on a volume of 101,000 shares in early trading on the Jakarta stock market.
